sudo tee /etc/NetworkManager/dispatcher.d/10-pin-gateway.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
INTERFACE="$1"
ACTION="$2"

if [ "$INTERFACE" != "wlan0" ]; then
    exit 0
fi

case "$ACTION" in
    up|dhcp4-change)
        if [ "$CONNECTION_ID" = "FTTH-AB0D" ] || [ "$IP4_GATEWAY" = "192.168.1.1" ]; then
            # 1. Permanently bind 192.168.1.1 to the exact physical router MAC
            ip neigh replace 192.168.1.1 lladdr 7c:a9:6b:10:ab:0d nud permanent dev "$INTERFACE"

            # 2. Drop any incoming ARP packet claiming 192.168.1.1 from any other MAC
            arptables -D INPUT -i "$INTERFACE" -s 192.168.1.1 ! --src-mac 7c:a9:6b:10:ab:0d -j DROP 2>/dev/null || true
            arptables -I INPUT -i "$INTERFACE" -s 192.168.1.1 ! --src-mac 7c:a9:6b:10:ab:0d -j DROP

            logger -t nm-dispatcher-arp "Locked wlan0 to router 7c:a9:6b:10:ab:0d (PERMANENT ARP & arptables DROP filter active)"
        fi
        ;;
    down)
        if [ "$CONNECTION_ID" = "FTTH-AB0D" ]; then
            ip neigh del 192.168.1.1 dev "$INTERFACE" 2>/dev/null || true
            arptables -D INPUT -i "$INTERFACE" -s 192.168.1.1 ! --src-mac 7c:a9:6b:10:ab:0d -j DROP 2>/dev/null || true
            logger -t nm-dispatcher-arp "Removed gateway lock on $INTERFACE"
        fi
        ;;
esac

exit 0
EOF
